sources.quote: MotheRetreat provides birth doula support to families across Fort Lauderdale and the Broward coast. Whether you plan to deliver at Broward Health Medical Center, Holy Cross Health, or Broward Health Imperial Point, your birth doula gives you continuous one-on-one support through labor and coordinates closely with your medical team.

city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula walking beside a pregnant partner along the Fort Lauderdale riverwalk: local birth support and doula care
city_fields.culture: Fort Lauderdale's expectation culture runs coastal and sun-soaked. Beach-town energy in the New River district, a dense network of OB practices on Atlantic and Las Ollas, and a large Latin community \u2014 Spanish-language birth resources genuinely matter here, and many local doulas and midwives work bilingually. Families delivering in the area typically land at one of the big Broward Health campuses, with Holy Cross Fort Lauderdale close behind. If you're planning a hospital birth, an out-of-hospital-style birth plan plus a doula who knows the L&D team is the combination that makes the difference.
city_fields.medicaidNote: Florida Medicaid (Family Plus/CHIP) covers doula services for eligible members \u2014 FL was one of the earlier states to add doulas to its Medicaid provider directory. Call 1-800-342-3526 (Access Florida) or check your plan to confirm current coverage before booking. If you're on a commercial plan, many FL plans cover part of the doula package \u2014 worth one call to the number on your card.
